senses.gloss:
भृङ्ग भृङ्ग, probably भ्रम्-ग,
 I. m., and f. गी (Kathās. 22, 103).
 1. A large bee, Ragh. 8, 52.
 2. A wasp.
 3. The fork-tailed shrike, Lanius cærulescens, Ṛt. 6, 24 (cf. Lass. 52, 18).
 4. A golden vase.
 5. A libertine.
 II. n.
 1. A plant, Woody cassia.
 2. Another, Verbesina prostrata Roxb.
भृङ्गक भृङ्ग + क, m. A bird, a sort of shrike.

भृङ्गार भृङ्गार (cf. भृङ्ग),
 I. m. A golden vase.
 II. n. Gold.
 III. f. री, A cricket.
भृङ्ग- + राज भृङ्ग- + राज, m. 1. a sort of bird (Lanius malabaricus), Lass. 52, 18. 2. the humble bee. 3. a sort of shrub. 4. a particular sacrifice.
